$comment: Routines the station ships with (engine.mjs seedRoutines). Each is inserted once per data root, ALWAYS disabled: enabling it in the office is the owner's approval (ENGINE-PLAN.md §5.4). A seed the owner deletes stays deleted. Real runs come after E6 (no provider keys until then). productKey (owner, 17/10/2026): the product key a research routine's job runs for, as data (engine.mjs runRoutine); the input text never names a product.

routines.name: Weekly genre scout
routines.input: Scout this week's genres: 2 currently popular AAA titles and 2 indie titles with active streaming communities, from trend articles, editorial roundups and community discussion. Write the internal notes and 4 genre briefs for the product_key in this run input.
